title: DER-exact DN comparison in cert.rs is the right default
description: names_equal() uses byte-exact DER comparison rather than RFC 5280 §7.1 string comparison. This is correct for the vast majority of certificate chains produced by conformant CAs. The alternative — implementing the full RFC 5280 DN matching algorithm — would add significant complexity (case folding, whitespace normalisation, mixed encoding rules for different string types) for a rare edge case. The real risk (MIME-1pu.4) is that non-conformant CAs exist in production; the mitigation is better documentation, not a full RFC 5280 matcher. A future contributor suggesting 'just add RFC 5280 DN matching' should be asked to identify which CAs they're trying to support and why simpler alternatives (cert pinning, pre-normalised trust stores) are insufficient.
close_reason: Design decision documented; no code change needed
